title: legousia speculum-veneris
intro: Legousia speculum-veneris, commonly known as Venus Looking Glass, is a flowering plant species in the bellflower family native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that aid in soothing skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Legousia speculum-veneris include its ability to reduce fever, promote digestion, and ease respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
